Drop off at your Las Vegas Strip hotel

blurb: We offer the only 4 hour Off-Road Racing Adventure in Las Vegas. Go as fast as your skills take you around our mile long off road course influenced by actual pro race tracks and includes 7 epic turns with 6 extreme jumps for the ultimate racing adventure! Race 7 laps around our pro dirt track with one on one instruction from a professional racing instructor. Hop into your very own pro race vehicle and receive live coaching through an onboard headset as you speed around the track just like the pros! Choose between a race Truck, Buggy, or Razor and take it to the track! To top it off Lunch is also included!
